verdict.rationale: Bento explicitly documents a dedicated transactional email API for account-triggered messages (receipts, password resets, login codes, order confirmations) that runs on the same platform/API as broadcasts and sequences, using the same auth (bento-docs-3, bento-docs-38, bento-docs-20). CLI and SDK docs also confirm transactional sending as a first-class supported operation (bento-docs-49). missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification of transactional deliverability or example code beyond docs.
